  Terse gloss: "to live together with, share life with; to cohabit or exist in common life with someone"
  Readable gloss: "A compound verb meaning to live together with, to share a common life. Paul uses it three times: 'if we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him' (Rom 6:8, 2 Tim 2:11), and declaring the Corinthians are in his heart 'to die together and to live together' (2 Cor 7:3). The word combines 'together' (συν-) with 'live' (ζάω), emphasizing shared existence—not just proximity but common life. Classical uses include living together domestically, dwelling alongside, or sharing a way of life."

    Existing Spanish translations: co-viviremos, vivir-juntos, viviremos-con

}
